Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Sunrise Ride

Chicago, IL · Bronzeville · Road

BIPOC

Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Sunrise Ride is a road group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls mondays and Tuesdays and Wednesdays and Thursdays and Fridays at 5:30 am from LA Fitness parking lot. About 20–25 miles, 12–13 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at @majortaylorchi the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Sunrise Ride group ride

Weekday sunrise ride from Bronzeville on the South Side. Easy pace, 20–25 miles, done by 7:30. Hosted by Chicago's Major Taylor club, a Black-led club open to all riders.
